desc:
Build your own zombie from mismatched limbs, then unleash it on the city! 🧟

🦴 BUY limbs as they roll off the conveyor belts: arms, legs, heads and torsos from Common to Mythic.
🔧 ATTACH them to your zombie, FUSE duplicates to level them up and UPGRADE them at the anvil.
💥 ENTER THE ARENA and rampage: eat humans, smash buildings, flip cars and earn cash.
🚨 Raise your WANTED level: police, SWAT and armored trucks come after you.
👹 Beat 6 BOSSES, from the Riot Chief to the final Omega.
✨ Collect limb SETS to unlock SUPER POWERS: Hook Pull, Laser Eye, Phase Dash, Rocket Barrage, Raise the Dead and more!
🔁 REBIRTH for a permanent cash multiplier and build an even crazier zombie.

🎁 Daily login and playtime rewards, quests, group rewards and codes.
🎮 Works on PC, mobile and console.

👍 Like and favorite for updates!
